b1-nemzetijelkepek-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Flag
b1-nemzetijelkepek-01.scenario: You are at a museum exhibition about national symbols. The guide, Mrs Kovács, asks you about the Hungarian flag.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-01.prompt: Tell her what the flag looks like and what the green stripe traditionally means.
cues: Say how many stripes and which colours
Say what green means by tradition
b1-nemzetijelkepek-01.target: A magyar zászló három vízszintes sávból áll: piros, fehér és zöld. A hagyomány szerint a zöld a reményt jelképezi.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-01.english: The Hungarian flag has three horizontal stripes: red, white and green. By tradition, green stands for hope.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-01.canDo: I can describe the Hungarian flag and say what its colours traditionally mean.

b1-nemzetijelkepek-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Holy Crown
b1-nemzetijelkepek-02.scenario: You are visiting the Parliament building with your class for the citizenship course. The guide asks what you know about the Holy Crown.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-02.prompt: Say where the Holy Crown is now and when it came back to Hungary.
cues: Say the year it came home
b1-nemzetijelkepek-02.target: A Szent Korona 2000 óta az Országházban van. 1978-ban tért haza az Egyesült Államokból.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-02.english: The Holy Crown has been in the Parliament building since 2000. It came home from the United States in 1978.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-02.canDo: I can say where the Holy Crown is kept and what the Doctrine of the Holy Crown says.

b1-nemzetijelkepek-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Coat of Arms
b1-nemzetijelkepek-03.scenario: In the citizenship interview, the examiner asks you about the coat of arms.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-03.prompt: Say what is in the first field of the coat of arms and what tradition says about the stripes.
cues: Say what the first field shows
Say what the silver stripes stand for by tradition
b1-nemzetijelkepek-03.target: Az első mezőben az Árpád-sávok vannak. A néphagyomány szerint a négy ezüst sáv négy folyót jelképez.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-03.english: The first field has the Árpád stripes. According to folk tradition, the four silver stripes symbolise four rivers.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-03.canDo: I can describe the Hungarian coat of arms and its two fields.

b1-nemzetijelkepek-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Himnusz
b1-nemzetijelkepek-04.scenario: A teacher, Mr Nagy, asks you about the Himnusz before a school ceremony on 22 January.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-04.prompt: Tell him who wrote the Himnusz, who composed the music, and what people do while it is sung.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-04.target: Kölcsey Ferenc írta a Himnusz szövegét, Erkel Ferenc pedig a zenéjét szerezte. Szokás, hogy az emberek felállnak.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-04.english: Ferenc Kölcsey wrote the text of the Himnusz and Ferenc Erkel composed its music. It is the custom for people to stand up.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-04.canDo: I can say who wrote the Himnusz and who composed its music, and when.

b1-nemzetijelkepek-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Szózat
b1-nemzetijelkepek-05.scenario: At a small ceremony, a woman from the choir asks if you know the Szózat.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-05.prompt: Say who wrote it and how it begins.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-05.target: Vörösmarty Mihály írta a Szózatot. Így kezdődik: Hazádnak rendületlenül légy híve, óh magyar.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-05.english: Mihály Vörösmarty wrote the Szózat. It begins: Hazádnak rendületlenül légy híve, óh magyar.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-05.canDo: I can say who wrote and who composed the Szózat, and recognise its first line.

b1-nemzetijelkepek-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: National Symbols in Short
b1-nemzetijelkepek-consolidation.scenario: In the citizenship interview, the examiner asks you which symbols the Fundamental Law names and who wrote the two poems.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-consolidation.prompt: Name the three state symbols and say who wrote the Himnusz and the Szózat.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-consolidation.target: A címer, a zászló és a Himnusz állami jelképek. A Himnuszt Kölcsey Ferenc írta, a Szózatot Vörösmarty Mihály.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-consolidation.english: The coat of arms, the flag and the Himnusz are state symbols. Ferenc Kölcsey wrote the Himnusz and Mihály Vörösmarty the Szózat.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about Hungary's national symbols and their authors.
